title: I Took the Parking-Meter Receipt to the Officer Who Ticketed a Paid Bay

parts.text: I paid until 3:12 p.m. and a ticket hit at 2:58. The meter still showed green. I was thirty-five, errand, holding a receipt QR. Officer Dale said the app lagged. I photographed the green, the QR, and the ticket time. Dale called it a buffer. Buffer is a word tickets use when a green exists. I uploaded the three stills to the contest portal. The ticket voided. Dale writes after red. The bay finally looks like a meter, not a guess. Nobody thanked me, which is how you know a policy finally works. A paper policy is only paper until someone treats it like a clock.

social.video_title: The ticket hit while the meter was still green — Part 1/1
social.description: Receipt QR, 2:58 ticket, a void. Has an officer ever called a green a buffer?
